description: Comparatorless charge-packet scouting probes each source through forward and reverse startup paths, ranks viable inputs, accumulates one minimum energy packet, then enables the main arbiter only once a safe handoff condition is latched.
mathematical_formalization: Choose source i maximizing ΔV_store/ΔQ_probe subject to I_backdrive_i <= I_limit and V_store >= V_handoff.
analogical_connections: speculative execution with commit only after validity
implementation_hypothesis: Use mirrored subthreshold pulse injectors plus capacitor slew comparison to estimate polarity/strength without an always-on comparator.
experiment_seed: Sweep mixed 20/50/100/300 mV sources, slow ramps, and 1:1/1:5/1:20 source impedances; compare startup success and back-drive loss against fixed-path and non-aware OR-ing baselines.

closest_prior_art.title: Fully Integrated Startup at 70 mV of Boost Converters for Thermoelectric Energy Harvesting
Configurable Hybrid Energy Synchronous Extraction Interface With Serial Stack Resonance for Multi-Source Energy Harvesting
Self-Powered Collaborative Energy Harvesting Interface Circuit for Stacked Multiple Piezoelectric Elements

novelty_claim: The claimed novelty is not lower startup voltage or better steady-state extraction; it is helper-free pre-arbitration source scouting under heterogeneous polarity and impedance before the main control loop exists.
differentiation: Differs from single-source TEG startup by explicitly addressing multi-source wrong-way current paths, and differs from recent multi-input piezo interfaces by making startup ranking itself the control problem rather than the steady-state extraction path.
predicted_failure_mode: Probe energy or mirror mismatch erases the gain, making it no better than a fixed startup path.
